findings.observed: trigger2_hyperposition_reference_labelers_v2.py separates exact evidence_event_id replay from correlation_ancestry_id and prevents correlated events from receiving independent_credit, but u_state still consumes observation.relation and target_branch_ids supplied upstream.
findings.consequence: The evidence-identity blocker is materially reduced, but the root semantic relation SUPPORTS/COUNTERS/FALSIFIES remains generator asserted unless another exact deterministic task-world derivation layer computes it.
findings.required_successor: Bind observation.relation and target branches to an executable formal-world derivation receipt whose source/hash/task-world input are immutable and mutation-tested.

findings.observed: d_resolve requires exactly one applicable live branch and all applicable competitors FALSIFIED; it therefore removes the earlier single-PROVE premature-collapse path.
findings.consequence: Unique-resolution semantics improve structurally, but the FALSIFIED state remains only as trustworthy as the upstream relation derivation that produced it.

findings.observed: The 14-row generator explicitly constructs branch_relations plus decision_role metadata and then calls the downstream labeler. This is useful source design, but it does not independently derive the semantic relation from facts/rules/observations.
findings.consequence: The 14 rows may remain candidate blueprints/source tests; they must not become accepted D/E training rows merely because the transition function is deterministic.

findings.observed: entityos_hcu_trainingtrace_candidate_gate_v2.py permits evidence_class=SYNTHETIC_DETERMINISTIC_LABEL to satisfy legacy hyperposition.resolution_status=RESOLVED_BY_EVIDENCE when the synthetic binding hashes are present.
findings.conflict: Current cross-cutting contract and ledger v2 require synthetic task resolution to remain distinct from causal/admitted evidence resolution.
findings.consequence: Hash-bound deterministic generation proves reproducibility/identity, not real-world causal evidence. Do not use this path for integrated admission until the type boundary is repaired.

findings.observed: tools/trigger2_semantic_hyperposition_gate_v2.py loads trigger2_semantic_hyperposition_reference_labelers_v1.py, but that duplicate labeler lane was removed from current main in favor of tools/trigger2_hyperposition_reference_labelers_v1.py. Exact-current fetch of the imported path returns Not Found.
findings.consequence: The semantic gate v2 cannot be credited as an exact-current executable admission path until it is rebased onto the surviving labeler identity and re-tested.

findings.observed: Ledger v2 marks trigger2_hyperposition_reference_labelers_v1.py CURRENT at its source scope, but subsequent causal-chain audit plus labeler v2, gate v2 and hard-negative artifacts changed the disposition frontier within minutes.
findings.consequence: Create ledger v3 so current/stale/blocked/superseded states remain explicit instead of allowing the fast-moving Trigger-2 corpus to silently mix authority epochs.

positive_deltas_retained: Semantic Hyperposition remains cross-cutting from the first integrated training episode.
Full v/K/E+/E-/F/T/A/sigma-style branch state is now represented in current labeler/generator work rather than only prose.
Labeler v2 now distinguishes exact event replay from correlated ancestry and can preserve correlated observations without independent credit.
Resolution now requires one remaining applicable live branch after competitors are falsified rather than a lone PROVE marker.
Discriminator ranking in labeler v2 computes pair separation from per-branch predicted outcomes instead of trusting only a pair-count integer.
V3 binding-router training quarantine remains in force because conditional nuisance leakage is still dispositive.

Twelve new hard-negative blueprints now preserve the exact failure modes so future successor data trains against circular labels, evidence replay, salience collapse, projection deletion and J-Space causality inflation.

research_incorporation.training_rule: Decodability or steering response is component evidence; positive J-Space causal labels require same-model intervention controls and off-target/retention evaluation.
Fully cross model-visible nuisances where feasible and require nuisance-only/conditional-information challenges; deterministic randomization alone is insufficient.
Use symbolic proof depth, unseen vocabulary/codebooks and causal mechanism tests as evaluation dimensions without hard-coding one hypothesized attention circuit as ground truth.
